name: Grease

components.m: a bit of pork rind or butter

targets.description: a 10-foot square of ground centered on a point

summary: Grease makes a 10-foot square Difficult Terrain; creatures there fail a Dexterity save or fall Prone.
text: Nonflammable grease covers a 10-foot square of ground centered on a point within range and makes it Difficult Terrain for 1 minute. Each creature standing in the area when the grease appears makes a Dexterity saving throw or has the Prone condition. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed on that save or fall Prone.
